rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something without stopping.

example.english: I continuously call him whenever I need help.
example.traditional: 我有需要就不停咁打電話畀佢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 zau6 bat1 ting4 gam2 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when an action or state continues throughout a period or along a course, emphasizing its ongoing duration.

example.english: The rain continuously fell until morning.
example.jyutping: jyu5 jat1 zik6 lok6 dou3 ziu1 zou2

rows.note: Use this conversational construction for someone or something carrying on doing V throughout the activity.

example.english: I continuously listen to music while cooking.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 lou6 zyu2 faan6 jat1 lou6 teng1 go1

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing an ongoing or recurring process that keeps happening without a break.

example.english: The phone continuously rang, so I couldn't sleep.
example.traditional: 電話不斷咁響，搞到我瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: din6 waa2 bat1 dyun6 gam2 hoeng2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 fan3 m4 zoek3
